name: memory-diagram
title: Memory diagrams
description: Pictures of memory (stack frames, heap objects, arrays, pointer arrows, linked nodes), trees of any arity and arrays, drawn from a small JSON scene; and a tracer that steps through scenes beside a code listing.

classPrefix.description: Prefix of the classes on hosts (<prefix>figure, <prefix>trace) and on generated elements (<prefix>frame, <prefix>cell, <prefix>arrow, …), for page CSS and scripts.

nullLabel.description: Text in a pointer cell whose "ptr" is null (e.g. "nullptr", "None").

resetLabel.description: Tracer: back to the first step.

stepLabel.description: Tracer status: {k} = current step, {n} = number of steps.

outputLabel.description: Tracer: heading of a step's printed output (the step's "out").
